About NileTech Solutions

 NileTech Solutions operates from Cairo, Alexandria, Dubai.

 Services
  • Business Process Automation — Replace manual back-office steps with governed
 workflows.
  • Custom Software Engineering — Build and maintain line-of-business systems end to end.
  • Data Platform Engineering — Consolidate scattered data into a governed analytics layer.
  • Systems Integration — Connect existing systems without replacing them.
  • Cloud Migration — Move workloads with a documented rollback path at every stage.
  • Managed Support — Ongoing operation and improvement of delivered systems.

 Contact

 General enquiries: hello@niletech.example


 How we deliver

 This section is synthetic text written for the parser benchmark.

 Every engagement starts with a short discovery phase. The team maps the current
 process, lists the systems it touches and agrees with the client which steps must never
 change.

 Work is delivered in two-week increments. Each increment ends with a demonstration on
 the client's own data and a written note of what changed, what was tested and what is still
 open.

 1. Discovery: map the process, the systems and the owners.

 2. Design: agree the target workflow and its controls.

 3. Build: deliver in increments with tests on real data.

 4. Handover: train operators and document the runbook.
